entry.title: Awesome Analytics Updates on Oct 21, 2026
entry.content:
General analytics

  • stratif.io - Open-source, self-hosted, warehouse-native product analytics. Runs funnels, retention, and path analysis directly on DuckDB, Postgres, Snowflake, or ClickHouse — no ingestion, no SDK. (Source Code (⭐10)) Apache-2.0 Python/TypeScript
  • Privatrak - Cookieless product analytics with visual event tracking, conversion funnels, and custom dashboards. © SaaS
  • OneQuery (⭐17) - Self-hosted gateway for safe, auditable queries for agents across approved data sources. Apache-2.0 Self-Hosted Rust
  • Kirro - A/B testing tool with visual editor and GA4 conversion tracking. 9KB script. © SaaS
  • ExperimentFlow - A/B testing and AI personalisation platform. Features neural bandits, lightweight SDK, privacy-first (no cookies, no PII). Google Optimize alternative. © SaaS
  • Sequential - session replay and product analytics with an AI judge that reviews each session and lists the findings to fix. © SaaS
  • DataSpoc Lens (⭐3) - Virtual warehouse over cloud Parquet (S3/GCS/Azure). SQL shell, Jupyter/Marimo notebooks, AI natural language queries, and local cache. (Source Code (⭐3)) Apache-2.0 Python
  • StackData - Free SaaS pricing comparison tool with pricing data; structured CSV datasets available for bulk analysis. © SaaS
  • Klinky - A/B testing link shortener that splits one link between two destinations, with click counts. © SaaS
  • Replayowl - Open source, self-hosted session replay that runs on Cloudflare Workers or Node. (Source Code (⭐1)) AGPL-3.0 TypeScript
  • Zoho Apptics – Cross-platfom analytics to monitor performance, analyze user behavior and collect feedback for mobile, web, and desktop apps.
  • rrweb - Open-source session replay library for the browser. Records the DOM and user interactions and replays them pixel-perfect. (Source Code (⭐20k)) MIT TypeScript

Analytics dashboards

  • Edalitics - Open source analytics/BI tool. (Source Code (⭐211)) © SaaS AGPL-3.0 Angular/Nodejs
  • DataPallas (⭐80) - Business intelligence platform with interactive dashboards, pivot tables and pixel-perfect report generation. SSPL-1.0 Source Available
  • GoatCounter Dashboard (⭐14) - Modern analytics dashboard for GoatCounter with interactive charts, choropleth world map, and demo mode. Single HTML file, no build step, no server. (Demo, Source Code (⭐14)) MIT JavaScript
  • Conyso Lens - General-purpose data-visualization studio: point it at any dataset and get publication-quality charts across 112 chart types, each with a plain-English, rule-based read (never AI-generated). Runs entirely in the browser; nothing you load ever leaves it. Self-host option available. © SaaS Self-Hosted
  • DAC - dashboard-as-code tool that defines dashboards in YAML and TSX, with a built-in semantic layer for metrics and dimensions. (Source Code (⭐795)) AGPL-3.0 Go Self-Hosted
  • AppRankly (⭐28) - Self-hosted dashboard bringing together iOS App Store Connect and Google Play Console metrics.
  • DataHub Pro - AI analytics for spreadsheets: turn an Excel or CSV file into dashboards, forecasts and reports, with an audit trail for every number. Built for small teams without a data engineer. SaaS
  • GeoSQL (⭐678) - AI-native geospatial analytics. Claude/Codex skill that turns natural language into validated SQL + maps on BigQuery and Snowflake. MIT Python
  • Dekart - Open-source geospatial analytics. Turn SQL on BigQuery/Snowflake/PostGIS into shareable interactive maps. (Source Code (⭐434)) AGPL-3.0 Go Self-Hosted SaaS
  • Analytics Compare - An independent, interactive database comparing 30+ analytics tools based on features, hidden costs, and scalability risks.

Mobile analytics

  • OpenPanel - OpenPanel is an open-source web and product analytics platform, an open-source alternative to Mixpanel with optional self-hosting. © Self-Hosted EU

Real-time

  • VisitorPing - Live website visitor dashboard with iPhone notifications for incoming visits. © SaaS

Website analytics

  • Vectr4 - Self-hosted web analytics with funnels and more. © Self-Hosted Docker

Endpoints

  • Rawbbit - Self-hosted analytics pipeline that lands raw events as Parquet in your own object storage. Designed for teams that want to own their raw event data instead of feeding it into a SaaS vendor's pipeline. Alternative to Firebase Analytics and Amplitude. (Source Code (⭐10)) Apache-2.0 Python

SEO

  • AuditorIA - Free automated SEO audit for local businesses. Detects HTTPS, meta tags, Schema markup, viewport, and phone visibility in 30 seconds. No registration required. © SaaS
  • FeedPulse - Free SEO checkers: domain authority, domain rating, SERP position, Google index status, page speed, plus a schema generator. Also serves embeddable traffic and visitor-country widgets. No signup, no paid tier. © SaaS
  • Vaneform - Free website traffic lookup: estimated monthly visits, traffic sources, top countries, search keywords and similar sites for any domain, no signup required. © SaaS
  • SiteData - website traffic estimation, reverse AdSense lookup, Google Ads advertiser analysis, and Domain Rating lookup. © SaaS
  • GeoBuddy - AI search analytics: tracks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity mention your brand, with rank, share of voice and competitor tracking; free check without signup.
  • LLM Pulse - AI search analytics for tracking brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and competitor share of voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode. © SaaS
  • NotFair (⭐3.9k) - Open-source Claude Code agent skills for SEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads, connecting to live data via Google Ads MCP, Meta Ads MCP, Google Search Console MCP, and Google Analytics (GA4) MCP. Covers site audits, keyword research, meta tags, schema markup, GEO optimization, wasted-spend detection, and creative analysis. (Source Code (⭐3.9k)) MIT

Privacy focused analytics

  • Logly - Cookieless web analytics with a sub-1KB tracker. Bots are counted separately and labelled by type — search engines, AI crawlers, SEO tools, monitors — instead of being filtered out silently. © SaaS
  • Stomatopod - Privacy-friendly, cookieless self-hosted web analytics. Single binary, embedded storage, no external DB. (Source Code (⭐1)) MIT Rust/Docker
  • Respectlytics - Privacy-first, session-based mobile app analytics with strict 5-field storage and no persistent user tracking. (Source Code (⭐41)) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker
  • PageLens - Cookieless, EU-hosted web analytics with revenue by traffic source and AI Visibility: which pages ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity read, use in answers and send visitors to. (Demo) © SaaS EU
  • Lomen - Cookie-free website analytics with an AI you can ask about your traffic, revenue from Stripe, Shopify, Lemon Squeezy and Polar next to visitors, and tracking of visits from ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. (Demo) © SaaS
  • measuremy.site - Cookieless web analytics your AI agent can read: an MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and other agents install the script and answer traffic questions. (Source Code (⭐1) for the self-hosted version) © SaaS MIT Self-Hosted
  • DevDome Analytics - Cookieless analytics for WordPress that separates human visitors from bots and AI crawlers. Free plan. (Plugin Source Code (⭐0)) GPL-2.0 SaaS
  • Statable - Privacy-first, cookieless web analytics hosted in the EU. Import your Google Analytics 4 history and keep a unified timeline. © SaaS EU
  • Facet (⭐2) - Cookieless, privacy-first web analytics & experimentation that runs entirely on the Cloudflare edge (Workers + D1). No cookies, no cross-session identity, raw IP is never stored; GPC/DNT respecting and self-hosted with a one-command deploy. AGPL-3.0 Cloudflare Workers
  • Ucoder Insight - Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics SDK for developers. 7.4kb gzipped, zero dependencies, offline support via IndexDB. (Source Code (⭐2)) MIT JavaScript
  • Beam - Lightweight, cookie-free web analytics on Cloudflare Workers and D1. No cookies, no fingerprinting, GDPR-compliant by design. Free tier included. (Source Code (⭐0)) © SaaS
  • Measure.events - Privacy-first web analytics with an agent-native API, MCP server, and natural language summaries. Built for AI-forward teams. © SaaS
  • d8a.tech - Open-source, GA4/Matomo-compatible analytics. Warehouse-native storage in BigQuery, ClickHouse, or files (CSV/Parquet). Available as EU-hosted cloud or self-hosted. MIT SaaS Self-Hosted Go/Docker

Heatmap analytics

  • Lupa - Self-hosted click heatmaps rendered directly on your page (no iframe), top clicked elements and scroll depth, plus session replay. (Demo, Source Code (⭐0)) AGPL-3.0 Go Self-Hosted
  • Hoot Lens - session replay, click heatmaps by device class and broken-click detection, readable by AI coding agents over MCP. © SaaS

App store analytics

  • AdMapix - AI ad intelligence and app market research platform for searching competitor creatives and tracking app rankings, downloads, and revenue across markets. © SaaS

Attribution tracking

  • ClickTrail - Deterministic first-party attribution engine for UTMs, ad click IDs, referrers, and first/last touch. (Source Code (⭐3)) MIT TypeScript
  • WhichPost - See which creator posts brought paying customers, from a read-only Stripe or RevenueCat connection, with a range on every result. © SaaS
  • Virling (⭐1) - open-source revenue attribution that ties each visit to the Stripe, Dodo Payments or Polar payment that followed. AGPL-3.0 Self-Hosted
  • OneLence - Marketing analytics: what to scale, hold or stop across ads, SEO, AI search and affiliates. © SaaS
  • mbuzz - server-side multi-touch attribution platform with open-source SDKs for Ruby, Node, Python, and PHP, plus a SQL-like attribution DSL. © SaaS

Social media analytics

  • Open Channel Stats - Browse real YouTube channels' full owner analytics — retention, CTR, traffic sources — published by the creators themselves, not estimated; connect your own free to compare. Daily refresh; each public channel exports as a documented SQLite file. © SaaS
  • SocialBu - AI-powered social media management and analytics platform with scheduling, monitoring, and automation. © SaaS
  • AI TikTok Analyzer Pro - TikTok content research: rank a creator's public videos by engagement, export comments, AI transcripts and sentiment analysis. © SaaS
  • Pulse - Social post metrics REST API — give it a public post URL and get back views, likes, comments, shares in JSON. Covers YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Mastodon, Instagram. No API key to start. Free SaaS

Developer analytics

  • Dev Ledger - Open-source GitHub analytics for developers — longitudinal development history across repositories: source growth, churn, activity, languages, and releases. (Source Code (⭐0)) AGPL-3.0 SaaS

entry.title: Awesome Analytics Updates on Oct 05, 2020

General analytics

Website analytics

  • KISSS - Very minimalistic (KISS) website statistics tool. (Source Code) MIT Go

Endpoints
